children: A cleaner home, without the harsh stuff
Plant-based, non-toxic cleaning for real homes — safe for kids, pets and sensitive noses, and gentle on everything you love.

children: Everything we use is plant-derived and low-fume — no bleach haze, no chemical smell lingering after we leave.

You’ll see the same person each visit — someone who learns your home, your preferences and what to leave alone.

children: Most cleaning leaves something behind — a chemical smell, a film on the counter, fumes that hang in a closed room for hours. In a home with kids, pets or anyone who reacts to that, it adds up.
We clean with plant-based products that actually work and don’t off-gas. Same fresh result, none of the residue — so the room you get back is genuinely clean, not just masked.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Verdi Clean is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A sunlit kitchen with open windows and green plants on the sill

children: Verdi Clean started with a simple frustration: cleaning a home shouldn’t mean filling it with fumes and chemicals, especially for families, pets and anyone with sensitive skin or lungs.
So we built a cleaning service around plant-based products and real care — the kind of clean you can feel good about, delivered by the same trusted person each time.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every clean uses non-toxic, low-fume products — never as an add-on or an upgrade. It’s just how we clean.
We note what to focus on and what to leave alone — fragile pieces, a napping baby, a nervous dog. It carries over every visit.
Refillable bottles, washable cloths and careful dosing mean less plastic and less down the drain — better for your home and the water it drains to.
